blocks.text: Potentiometer zyada tar potential differences ka muwazna karne aur na-maloom resistance ki qeemat nikalne ke liye istemal hota hai. Kitab kehti hai ke yeh Wheatstone bridge ke usool par kaam karta hai: bridge ki tarah yeh bhi balance (null) nuqte par istemal hota hai.

Potential difference aam taur par voltmeter naami aale se napa jata hai, jo un do nuqton ke darmiyan jora jata hai jin ka potential difference napna ho. Voltmeter ki resistance us circuit resistance ke muqable bari honi chahiye jis par woh jora jaye; warna voltmeter se qabil-e-zikr current behega, jo circuit ka current aur napne wala potential difference badal dega. Yun voltmeter sahi potential difference tabhi parhta hai jab circuit se koi current na le; misali (ideal) voltmeter ki resistance la-mehdood hogi. Kuch aalaat, jaise digital voltmeter aur cathode-ray oscilloscope, apni bari resistance ki wajah se amalan koi current nahi lete aur bohat durust hain, magar mehngay aur istemal mein mushkil hain. Potential differences ko durusti se napne aur muwazna karne wala bohat saada aala potentiometer hai.

Potentiometer ek taar ki shakal ke resistor R par mushtamil hai jis par terminal C sarak sakta hai (Fig. 9.31a). Sarakne wala rabta C A se B tak le jane par A aur C ke darmiyan resistance 0 se R tak badalti hai. Agar emf E ki battery R par jori jaye (Fig. 9.31b) to us mein current I = E/R hai. Agar A aur C ke darmiyan resistance r ho to in nuqton ke darmiyan potential ki girawat rI = rE/R hai. Yun C ko A se B tak le jane par r 0 se R tak badalta hai aur A aur C ke darmiyan girawat 0 se E tak badalti hai. Aise intezam ko potential divider bhi kehte hain.

Potential divider se kisi source ka na-maloom emf napa ja sakta hai (Fig. 9.32). R yaksan cross-section ke seedhe taar ki shakal mein hai. Jis cell ka emf Ex napna ho use galvanometer G ke zariye A aur sarakne wale rabte C ke darmiyan jora jata hai; Ex ka musbat terminal aur potential divider ka musbat terminal ek hi nuqte A se jure hain. Agar loop AGCA mein nuqta C aur Ex ka manfi terminal ek potential par hon to galvanometer ke dono terminals ek potential par hain aur us mein koi current nahi behta. To C ki jagah tab tak badli jati hai jab tak galvanometer koi jhukao na dikhaye; tab emf Ex, A aur C ke darmiyan potential difference ke barabar hai jis ki qeemat Er/R maloom hai. Yaksan cross-section ke taar mein resistance lambai ke tanasub mein hai, to Ex = E r/R = E l/L ... (9.52), jahan L taar AB ki kul lambai aur l, C ko be-jhukao karne ke baad A se C tak lambai hai.

Chunke A aur C ke darmiyan zyada se zyada potential E hai, na-maloom emf Ex is se zyada nahi hona chahiye; warna null shart nahi milegi. Na-maloom emf tab napa jata hai jab us se koi current na liya jaye, is liye potentiometer potential napne ke durust tareen tareeqon mein se hai.

Yehi tareeqa do cells ke emfs E1 aur E2 ka muwazna kar sakta hai. Dono cells ke liye balance lambaiyan l1 aur l2 alag alag nikali jati hain; tab E1 = E l1/L aur E2 = E l2/L. Taqseem karne par E1/E2 = l1/l2 ... (9.53). Yun emfs ki nisbat balance lambaiyon ki nisbat ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: Potentiometer kya hai? Us ka kaam bayan kijiye (comprehensive question 9.5). Yeh aam voltmeter se zyada durust kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh lamba yaksan resistance wala taar hai jis mein driver cell se mustaqil current behta hai, to potential us ke saath barabar girta hai; na-maloom emf galvanometer ke zariye sarakne wale rabte se jora jata hai, jise tab tak hilaya jata hai jab tak galvanometer koi jhukao na dikhaye, aur tab Ex = E l/L. Balance par yeh napne wale cell se koi current nahi leta, to asal emf napta hai, jabke voltmeter hamesha kuch current leta hai aur is liye kam terminal voltage parhta hai.

items: Voltmeter tabhi durust hai jab current na le. Potentiometer: yaksan taar AB, sarakne wala rabta C aur driver cell E; potential divider rE/R, 0 se E.
Null tareeqa: Ex = E l/L (9.52), Ex, E se zyada na ho; E1/E2 = l1/l2 (9.53); na-maloom cell se current nahi liya jata, to bohat durust.
